title: An acceptance authored at `fontScale=1.5` does not apply at the default frame
why: Overrides change layout and a mask is geometry, so an acceptance for a glyph at one font scale covers different pixels at another. Matching is exact over the **whole** map — every key the render lane accepts, including `knob.<key>` and `rc.<name>`, because a key that did not affect the render would not be in the map.
